name: CleanSpark, Inc.
summary: CleanSpark, Inc. operates as a data center developer in the United States. The company operates through two segments: Bitcoin Mining and Data Center Infrastructure. It develops data centre infrastructure for AI and HPC hosting and leasing, as well as owns, leases, and operates data centers and power assets. The company was formerly known as Stratean Inc. and changed its name to CleanSpark, Inc. in November 2016. CleanSpark, Inc. was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Henderson, Nevada.
